title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai

thread.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day • Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai - Episode 7 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers found the episode emotionally powerful and well executed, with strong buildup and memorable character-focused drama.
Several comments praised the combat-readiness sequence and the way it revealed character abilities and emotional nuance.
The episode’s character development, especially Mimi’s changing emotional perspective, was frequently viewed as compelling.
Some viewers thought the episode was effective but rushed, saying key transitions and emotional beats deserved more time.
A number of viewers criticized the institution’s treatment of the children and found its military system cruel and exploitative.
The special ending and its vocal performance were widely considered emotionally effective.

title: Tai-Ari deshita.: Ojou-sama wa Kakutou Game nante Shinai

thread.title: Young Ladies Don’t Play Fighting Games • Tai-Ari deshita. Ojou-sama wa Kakutou Game Nante Shinai - Episode 7 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters found the episode highly entertaining, energetic, and fun, with strong anticipation for the next episode.
The cast’s exaggerated intensity, rivalries, emotional relationships, and comedic moments were frequently praised.
Several comments highlighted the fighting-game presentation and tournament developments as exciting.
Some viewers enjoyed the dramatic character material, while others felt the show’s escalation was overly melodramatic or difficult to take seriously.
Multiple commenters were uninterested in the extended focus on side characters’ backstories, especially compared with the main cast.
